name: usage_analytics
description: View usage statistics: overall summary, per-skill breakdown, daily/hourly request counts, cost breakdown, or top used skills. NOTE: currently returns all-zero data - no persistent tracking mechanism is wired up yet (stats reset on every call since they're stored in-memory on a fresh instance each time, not read from a real database).

action.description: summary: overall totals. skill_usage: per-skill breakdown. daily/hourly: time-bucketed counts. cost_breakdown: estimated cost per skill. top_skills: most-used skills. reset: clear stats.

days.description: Number of days for action='daily'. Defaults to 7.

hours.description: Number of hours for action='hourly'. Defaults to 24.

limit.description: Max skills for action='top_skills'. Defaults to 10.
